toes_L.note: kinematic toe curl/extension (EHL L5, FHL S1-S2)

driver.rule: swing-twist decompose the source bone's local rotation about its rest twist axis (axes.twist of the source joint, world at rest); set this bone's local rotation to factor x that twist angle about its own axes.twist

upper_arm_twist_L.note: carries the proximal upper arm; world twist = 50 % of the shoulder twist (skin twists 0/50/100 %)

driver.rule: swing-twist decompose the source bone's local rotation about its rest twist axis (axes.twist of the source joint, world at rest); set this bone's local rotation to factor x that twist angle about its own axes.twist

forearm_twist_L.note: carries the mid/distal forearm; 50 % of the hand's pronation/supination (the hand body folds forearm rotation into its twist axis)

toes_R.note: kinematic toe curl/extension (EHL L5, FHL S1-S2)

jaw.rule: open = rotation about axes.open.world through the bone head (TMJ hinge) PLUS a bone translation of glide_m_per_deg x max(open, 0) in body-frame metres (condyle sliding down the articular eminence); the weights assume both
jaw.note: hinge about +X through the TMJ pivot (bone head, B2 measured); see face.jaw_*

tongue.note: child of jaw; falls back at death (G6)

eye_L.note: gaze = bone -Y (body frame); B2: clamp beyond ~30 deg near the corners

lid_upper_L.note: rotation about +X through the eyeball centre plus the uniform scale of face.lid_table (B2)

lid_lower_L.note: rotation about +X through the eyeball centre plus the uniform scale of face.lid_table (B2)

eye_R.note: gaze = bone -Y (body frame); B2: clamp beyond ~30 deg near the corners

lid_upper_R.note: rotation about +X through the eyeball centre plus the uniform scale of face.lid_table (B2)

lid_lower_R.note: rotation about +X through the eyeball centre plus the uniform scale of face.lid_table (B2)

face.jaw_note: opening = +rotation about +X through jaw_pivot (TMJ hinge, condyle centres); death jaw drop 10-30 mm = 6-19 deg [RB §5.6]

lid_scale_rule.note: closing lid bones scale up so the lid rides over the cornea (apex 13.3 mm)

lid_table.sign: upper_deg > 0 lifts the upper margin (opens); lower_deg > 0 lowers the lower margin (opens); rotation axis = body +X (Godot +X) through the eyeball centre (bone head); upper lid world rotation = -upper_deg about +X, lower lid = +lower_deg about +X; the scale columns are uniform bone scales about the eyeball centre

elbow.unit: deg (elevation angle from the joint centre)

knee.unit: deg (elevation angle from the joint centre)

weights.jaw: Voronoi mandible vs skull (head project SDFs), +-4 mm blend; throat sheet JAW_THROAT

notes.limits: degrees about axes[*].world; positive = axes[*].pos direction
notes.torque_cap_nm: per direction key, before tone/paralysis multipliers (plan §3.2)
notes.b2g: Godot = (x, z, -y) of every vector here
notes.twist_bones: drive kinematic.*_twist_*.driver every frame, else they carry 100 % of the twist like their parent (no candy-wrap relief)
